title: Journey North through Tohoku and Hokkaido
alt: Matsushima Bay islands seen from the water, Japan
transport: Bullet trains, coaches and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large four star hotel beside Shinagawa station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights beside Shinagawa station, with free time in Shinjuku and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Sendai
stops.subtitle: Sendai via Nikko
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel beside Sendai station

activities.name: Nikko sightseeing tour
activities.description: The lacquered Toshogu shrine in its cedar forest, the Shinkyo bridge and the Kegon falls on the way north.

program.name: Sendai
program.description: A night in Sendai, reached through Nikko's shrines and waterfalls on the drive north.

stops.name: Morioka
stops.subtitle: Morioka via Matsushima and Hiraizumi
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Reliable hotel at Morioka station in northern Tohoku

activities.name: Kanrantei tea house
activities.description: A sixteenth century tea pavilion looking out over Matsushima bay, given to the local lord by Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

activities.name: Matsushima bay cruise
activities.description: A cruise through the pine topped islands of Matsushima, counted among the three great views of Japan.

activities.name: Hiraizumi sightseeing
activities.description: The gold leaf hall of Chuson-ji and the garden temple of Motsu-ji, all that is left of a northern capital.

program.name: Morioka
program.description: A night in Morioka, with a tea house and bay cruise at Matsushima and the gold hall at Hiraizumi on the way.

stops.name: Hakodate
stops.subtitle: Hakodate via Hirosaki and Aomori
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Harbour hotel in Hakodate, on the southern tip of Hokkaido

activities.name: Hirosaki castle
activities.description: A small keep inside a wide moat, ringed by two and a half thousand cherry trees that draw crowds every spring.

activities.name: Nebuta museum
activities.description: The hall in Aomori that keeps the giant painted lantern floats from the summer festival, lit and close enough to touch.

program.name: Hakodate
program.description: A night on the Hokkaido coast, reached through Hirosaki castle and the lantern floats of Aomori.

stops.name: Sapporo
stops.subtitle: Sapporo via Onuma and Noboribetsu
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in central Sapporo, near Susukino

activities.name: Goryokaku tower
activities.description: The tower above Hakodate's star shaped fort, best seen from the air with the ramparts laid out below.

activities.name: Onuma Quasi-National Park
activities.match: Leisure Time in Onuma Quasi National Park
activities.description: Free time among the lakes and islets below Mount Hokkaido-Komagatake, linked by small bridges and walking paths.

activities.name: Oyunuma lake at Noboribetsu
activities.description: A steaming sulphur lake in the hell valley at Noboribetsu, with a hot stream you can soak your feet in.

activities.name: Sapporo sightseeing tour
activities.description: The clock tower, Odori park and the old government building, with a stop at the Sapporo beer museum.

activities.name: Hill of the Buddha
activities.description: Tadao Ando's lavender ringed hill, where a great stone Buddha sits with only its head showing above the rim.

activities.name: Otaru canal town
activities.description: Free time in Otaru, where the canal, stone warehouses and glass workshops make the best afternoon in Hokkaido.

program.name: Sapporo
program.description: Two nights in the island capital, reached through Onuma park and the Noboribetsu hell valley, with a city day, the Hill of the Buddha and Otaru.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: North from Tokyo through Tohoku to Hokkaido, with twelve included visits and barely another foreign traveller in sight.
expert.tip: This is a moving trip with four single nights, so pack light. The reward is Matsushima and Otaru without a queue anywhere.

summary: Eight days north from Tokyo: a guided city day, Nikko on the way to Sendai, the bay cruise at Matsushima and the gold hall at Hiraizumi, Hirosaki castle and the Aomori lantern floats, then Hakodate and two nights in Sapporo with Otaru.
included: Included: 7 nights across five towns with daily breakfast; bullet trains and coaches throughout; guided sightseeing in Tokyo, Nikko and Sapporo; Kanrantei tea house and Matsushima bay cruise; Hiraizumi sightseeing; Hirosaki castle and Nebuta museum tickets; Goryokaku tower; free time at Onuma park and Otaru; Oyunuma lake at Noboribetsu; the Hill of the Buddha.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
